summary: Configured node1’s staged projects directory as the authenticated SMB share `projects`. Node2 can list, read, and update files as `designer`; guest, sibling-share, and traversal access are rejected. Original drawings remain unchanged. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu Xenial-compatible Samba 4.3.11 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created the `design` group and locked `designer` system account, then configured Samba authentication using the staged demonstration credential.
Applied setgid group-writable permissions to the projects directory while retaining restrictive permissions on sibling content.
Created and updated `node2-update.txt` from node2 through SMB.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified persistent service, data, and access behavior.

evidence.summary: Configuration validates with `valid users = @design`, writable masks, correct path, active/enabled smbd, and listeners on ports 139/445.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Authenticated listing, existing-file read, document replacement, round-trip comparison, and final post-restart access all passed.
Guest tree connections return ACCESS_DENIED; the private sibling is not shared; traversal attempts are rejected.
Before and final SHA-256 hashes match for drawing.txt and materials.csv.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating system and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic; distribution Samba 4.3.11 is used.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered smbd/listeners/data, authenticated remote access, and continued guest rejection.
Captured healthy client baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SMB client operation, and successful post-restart list/read/update with access restrictions intact.
